level.name: 설날에는 밥 대신 떡국을 먹어요
level.nameEn: 2B Unit 16 · We eat tteokguk instead of rice on New Year’s Day
level.description: Farm the Unit 16 word list — the two big holidays, the food they are kept with, and the housework that gets them ready.
level.descriptionEn: Explore Korean holidays, traditional food and housework through illustrated vocabulary, listening practice and workbook exercises.
